title: Return-to-work panels / concise session orientation
name: Return-to-work panels / concise session orientation
audience: Returning human operator; agent reading live continuity first
scope: Global summary outside a project; project/item summary inside one
trigger: User returns or asks what to do next; at startup the agent receives facts and surfaces human text only when useful/actionable
proposed_purpose: Restore orientation and resume safely without repeating the introductory course.
content: Where you are: universe and selected project or no project.
What is active, waiting on you, blocked, or recently completed, with titles rather than bare IDs.
For interrupted work: last durable checkpoint, current holder/lane, evidence state and the live next-step pointer.
For a decision: say whether it approves work, reviews QA evidence or accepts a deployment.
For a missing prerequisite: one reason and one action/help link at the point it matters.
For a nearly finished initiative: offer a completion/evidence audit and deferred-work review before archival.

scope_variants.global: A short cross-project status plus the right project/folder link. Cross-project coordination does not switch an existing session’s project.
scope_variants.project: Current plan, active work, personal Inbox and delivery state; links to their existing pages rather than repeating them all.
scope_variants.noneActive: Offer to select ready work or steer the current plan; do not imply Feed must precede Steer.

authority_and_reuse: Reuse orientation, durable checkpoints, Frontier/Sessions/Inbox/Shipping, and the existing onboarding panel. No separate progress database or prescribed multi-stage tour. Unreadable facts stay unknown; preference and cue-dedup policy remains an open JOURNEYS decision.
proposal_status: Proposed future human rendering of current/planned context facts; archival completion audit is explicitly planned
